consensus_strengths: The snapshot is candidly theory-only: it excludes untraceable historical empirical material and does not present the unrun future policy as evidence.
T1 and T3 are compact, self-contained statements with explicit non-transfer caveats; T2 correctly identifies that its directional statement needs an invariant-subspace premise.
The manuscript is readable and clearly distinguishes its narrow formal regimes from nonlinear SGD, neural-network, deployment, and real-noise claims.
consensus_weaknesses: The stated training-path/intervention problem is not formalized by a comparison between intervened and reference paths: D has no operative role in the results, T2 starts from an arbitrary post-switch iterate, and T3 has no intervention variable.
T2's printed segment-level smoothness/strong-convexity premise does not unambiguously imply the ambient spectral Hessian bounds used by its full-norm proof.

The three elementary product/contraction results have no demonstrated joint novelty or decision-relevant consequence, and the related-work record lacks direct optimization and stochastic-recursion antecedents.
The build record contains an incorrect hash for an included AI-use input, and its deterministic-build assertion is therefore not yet auditable against the archived PDF.
The planned empirical policy is explicitly unrun and underdefined; this is acceptable for a theory-only paper but cannot support the practical attribution or unlearning framing.

positions: Four reviewers rate the paper 4, treating the central deficiencies as substantial but potentially repairable.
The novelty reviewer rates it 2 because the current theorems appear elementary and lack a demonstrated research contribution.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Assign 4: the paper is decision-ready enough to assess and has real scoped formal content, but the unresolved T2 premise, unsupported intervention framing, and unestablished novelty make it marginally below threshold.

positions: The experimental reviewer offers an executed matched-path experiment as one route to substantiate practical relevance.
The theory-focused reviews show that truthful reframing and a correct formal result can be evaluated without an experiment.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Do not require an experiment for a theory-only revision. Remove practical significance claims unless a preregistered, executed study is supplied; prioritize the formal correction and framing first.

positions: The novelty reviewer reasonably finds no snapshot evidence of theorem-level distinction from standard analyses.
The isolated record cannot establish that external prior work definitively subsumes every submitted statement.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Treat missing direct theoretical positioning as a supported major deficiency, but do not claim proven external subsumption without a source-verified theorem-level comparison.

positions: The reproducibility review reports a clean rebuild hash mismatch in addition to the incorrect recorded input hash.
The snapshot itself directly confirms the incorrect recorded AI-use-file hash, but does not pin a toolchain sufficient to independently attribute a PDF mismatch.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Require a regenerated, toolchain-pinned source-to-PDF evidence chain; treat the wrong input hash as established and the precise cause of the PDF mismatch as unverified.

unsupported_reviewer_claims.reason: The snapshot supports that the proofs use standard-looking arguments and lacks a stated joint consequence, but it cannot by itself prove that no distinctive advance exists in the external literature.

The directly checkable incorrect ai_use_statement.tex hash is supported. The reported clean-rebuild PDF mismatch is not independently reproducible from the snapshot because no pinned compiler/container is supplied.

prioritized_actions.description: Replace T2's ambiguous segment-level premise with explicit pointwise ambient Hessian bounds on every relevant minimizer-to-iterate segment, or give a valid weaker proof. Re-audit the proof and align abstract and limitations wording.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: The printed assumptions imply the integrated bound mu I <= Hbar_t <= L I used in the proof, and the old off-segment counterexample is excluded or otherwise handled.

prioritized_actions.description: Unless a new comparator-path theorem is proved, retitle and reframe the paper as three scoped product/contraction identities. Remove claims that they analyze an intervention block, training-path dependence, or clean-path return; define any retained motivation as future work and add a compact scope matrix.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: A blind read of the title, abstract, introduction, theorem statements, and conclusion finds no claim of intervened-versus-reference-path analysis absent a corresponding formal definition and theorem.

prioritized_actions.description: Add source-verified, theorem-level comparisons to direct prior theory for linear gradient-descent products, smooth strongly-convex contraction, and affine stochastic recursions. State the exact nontrivial gap filled, or explicitly present the paper as exposition rather than a novel research contribution.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Each main result has a direct antecedent comparison specifying assumptions, conclusion, and a substantiated distinction; any remaining novelty claim follows from that comparison.

prioritized_actions.description: Regenerate the PDF and audit records from one frozen source tree in a pinned TeX/BibTeX environment; correct every consumed-input hash and reconcile citation-lock status with the closest-work matrix.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: A clean pinned rebuild reproduces the manifest PDF hash and all dependency hashes; active citekeys have one consistent, non-pending provenance status.

must_resolve_before_accept: Correct or rigorously restate T2 so that its full-norm contraction follows from its printed assumptions.
Remove the unsupported intervention/path-dependence interpretation or prove a nontrivial theorem comparing explicit intervention and reference trajectories.
Establish a theorem-level novelty boundary against direct prior theory; reframing alone cannot establish an accept-level research contribution.
Produce a reproducible source-to-PDF provenance chain with correct dependency hashes.
score_gaming_suggestions_to_reject: Do not restore remote-only numerical results, broaden deployment claims, or treat the planned policy as evidence without a frozen and executed evidence chain.
Do not add a cosmetic scope table, extra caveats, or citations as a substitute for correcting T2 and establishing a substantive novelty boundary.
Do not run an unrelated empirical benchmark merely to increase apparent completeness while retaining no claim that the experiment tests.
decision_rationale: Isolated meta-reviewer erase-r1-meta finds all reviews tied to the specified snapshot. The paper's careful scope control and self-contained T1/T3 content prevent a categorical finding that it is unreviewable, but the central T2 assumption-proof mismatch is material, the headline intervention interpretation is not delivered by any theorem, and the isolated record does not establish a distinct ICLR-level theoretical contribution. These are reasons to reject that narrowly outweigh the verified strengths, yielding 4 (marginally below), with a current evidence ceiling of 4.
